title: District of 93 platforms in a sheltered bay (Design C)

provenance.basis: Illustrative archetype for projects/floating-city-design-challenge (scenario SCN_FLOATCITY_COASTAL_01); not an engineering design. Design C: 93 platforms of 60 m with three-storey buildings (draft 2.917 m from district_C); 66 home platforms inside, 27 service platforms on the seaward row and flanks; link-spans, piles in the shallow rows, conceptual mooring lines on the deep ring, a breakwater on the open side, utility spines (power, water, wastewater), boat landings, emergency routes. The link-spans are 25 m long (shore_gap_m), the bridge length of link_span.25_m_bridge in results.json.
